profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Xbox | Microsoft

positions.title: Student Assistant
positions.description:
• Assist high school students with their personal computer science-related projects
• Introduce students to programming languages
• Create and manage the webpages for the K-12 programs at the College of Computing
• Create advertisements for the K-12 programs

positions.title: Explorer Intern
positions.description: • Rotate between Program Manager, Software Developer and Software Developer Engineer in Test positions on the Microsoft SharePoint team

positions.title: Front End Developer Intern
positions.description:
•Redesign the website for eCommHub, a local e-commerce company that specializes in drop-shipping
•Construct wireframes to map out user interfaces for the website and for the internal software

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:

• Recorded manual SQL modification requests
• Improved the search engine on Careerbuilder website by analyzing the search result data
